content: {"episode_id":"ep-05159","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93271, cardiac event monitoring, for episode ep-05159. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats, prompting further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia. As stated in the note, the cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances by capturing electrocardiographic data during symptom onset. The claim was submitted with diagnosis codes I49.9 and R00.2, and we request reconsideration of the denial on the basis of this documented clinical necessity."}
